Place "{argument name="main text" default="AI VISUAL EDITOR"}" in huge, bold English typography behind the subject, using textured orange letters on a dark vintage background. Add professional-themed text on the left side: "AI VISUAL EDITOR is more than a career. It is passion, discipline, growth, and impact. Every challenge builds expertise, every step creates success. Focused on progress. Driven by purpose." Subtly integrate the branding handle "{argument name="handle" default="AIwithkinza"}" on the clothing. Include the signature watermark "Kinza 💫" subtly in the bottom corner of the design. Premium poster aesthetic, cinematic lighting, clean composition, grain texture, ultra-detailed digital illustration, 4K, 9:16 aspect ratio.
